description:
Jaeyoon’s got a secret he’s keeping from the rest of the world… and it’s that he’s a hidden stan of the popular male idol group, NOWAY. Not only that, he ships two of the members together with all his heart. He just can’t stop daydreaming about the two members on the team getting together in various scenarios, even when he’s at school. Well, a little daydreaming never hurt anyone, right? Or so he thought. But it seems his classmate Yihyun, who’s tall and athletic and good-looking, has a little secret of his own. Somehow, he seems to be privy to all the unfiltered, perverted thoughts going through Jaeyoon’s mind, and he certainly wants them to stop. This is certainly bizarre, but Jaeyoon can’t help thinking he could put Yihyun’s “powers” to better use… 

(Source: Lezhin)
